description_en: Queries the details of a Database Backup Service (DBS) backup plan created on the MyBase instance management page. An empty response indicates that no backup plan is created for the managed instance
description_zh: 查询在 MyBase 实例纳管页创建的 DBS 备份计划详情，返回为空时说明纳管实例未创建备份计划
name: DescribePrinsBackupPlan

parameters.help_en: The region ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the self-managed instance
parameters.name: instance_name

BackupPeriod.description_en:
The full backup cycle. Valid values:
Monday: Monday
Tuesday: Tuesday
Wednesday: Wednesday
Thursday: Thursday
Friday: Friday
Saturday: Saturday
Sunday: Sunday

You can specify multiple values separated by commas (,)
BackupPeriod.description_zh:
全量备份周期，取值：
Monday：周一
Tuesday：周二
Wednesday：周三
Thursday：周四
Friday：周五
Saturday：周六
Sunday：周日

支持选择多个取值，用英文逗号（,）分开

BackupPlanCreateTime.description_en: The creation timestamp of the backup plan

BackupPlanName.description_en: The name of the backup plan

BackupPlanStatus.description_en:
The backup plan status. Valid values:
wait: not configured
init: not started (precheck failed)
running: running
stop: failed
pause: paused
locked: locked
check_pass: precheck passed
BackupPlanStatus.description_zh:
备份计划状态，返回值如下：
wait：未配置
init：未启动（预检查失败）
running：运行中
stop：失败
pause：暂停
locked：锁定中
check_pass：预检查通过

BackupStartTime.description_en: The backup start time in the HH:mm format

DatabaseType.description_en:
The database type. Valid values:

MYSQL
DatabaseType.description_zh:
数据库类型，取值如下：

MYSQL

InstanceClass.description_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

micro: entry-level
small: low-spec
medium: medium-spec
large: high-spec
xlarge: high-spec (no traffic limit)
InstanceClass.description_zh:
规格，返回值如下：

micro：入门型
small：低配型
medium：中配型
large：高配型
xlarge：高配型（无流量上限）

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group

UserName.description_en: The name of the database account used for backup
UserName.description_zh: 备份使用的数据库账号名

OssHint.description_en:
Indicates whether the user has activated Object Storage Service (OSS).
<notice>If the value is false, you cannot create a backup plan. You must activate OSS first.></notice>
OssHint.description_zh:
用户是否已开通 OSS 服务。
<notice>若返回为 false 则无法正常创建备份计划，需要先开通 OSS 服务。></notice>
